content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing issues transferring a program from my computer to my newly purchased [product_name] [article_no] using an Ethernet cable. I can establish a successful connection between my PC/Laptop and the [product_name] device (tested via the transfer tool), even with various IP configurations. However, when I attempt to initiate the program transfer, the download dialog appears briefly, but nothing happens and there’s no feedback provided in the information bar. The dialog only shows 'connecting to BM' before disappearing. I have no idea what steps to take next. I've already tried disabling WLAN and all firewall settings, but this didn’t solve the issue. I’ve used several manually set IP addresses without success, created a new simple program (just one input and one output), but still no download occurs. Rebooting the computer and resetting the [product_name] device to factory settings also yielded no results. If anyone has suggestions beyond abandoning the device, I would appreciate any advice. Thank you,
Thank you, it worked! I'm glad for the solution, though a bit surprised by it.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faced challenges transferring programs to a newly purchased [product_name] [article_no] device over Ethernet using [product_name] software. Despite successful connection tests and varied troubleshooting—disabling firewall, resetting the device, trying different IPs and programs—the transfer failed without useful feedback. The issue was resolved by updating the [product_name] software to a compatible version, which addressed hardware/software compatibility problems.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects straightforward and reliable program transfers to new hardware using their current software and connection setup, with helpful feedback in case of any failure.
